name: 503 (Heliopolis Rock)
headline: Distinct & Decent 2 BDR Apt. | Steps From Nightlife and Airport
summary: This 2 bedroom furnished apartment is closest to Airport (5 min away), restaurants and dining options are at walking distance (Sun City Mall & Cairo Complex). Located in the Heliopolis district which is considered upscale, safe and very accessible to highway roads and the ring road which connects the whole city of Cairo. It's great for couples, families and is perfect for work trips too.

description.Space:
The apartment features 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, one of which is ensuite and a spacious colorful living room with a couch, a dining  table and a fully equipped kitchen with a Nespresso coffee machine and a kettle. Cooking utensils are also available. There is cable and smart TV to stream your favorite content along with fast and reliable Wifi.
There are 2 bedrooms one of which has a queen size bed and is ensuite and an additional separate bedroom with two single beds.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is packed with cafés and restaurants along Ankara street which is close to the apartment. 
This neighborhood is full of life with plenty of street food options (the apartment is quite and peaceful though) 

- Banks and other services are also within walking distance. 

- There is a sports complex for most sports activities (running track, football, basketball, squash, tennis..) which is a 10 min walk from the apartment. 

- Sun City Mall and Cairo Complex are within 5 min walking distance. 
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 5 min drive.
description.Transit: All places are reachable by car and Uber but if you want take a walk it's not going to take you more than 5 minutes to reach any of the services around.
description.Notes: Please note that additional unreported guests are not allowed to access or enter the property.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

A beautiful and contemporary apartment! Super clean, very spacious, easy to communicate with the host. It’s around 5 min driving distance from the airport. Within walking distance, there’re many choices of restaurants. The apartment also has a washing machine, so we got some laundry done from the trip.

It was a little challenge to find the entrance of the building. The residence entrance is on the side instead of in the front. Fortunately the host was available on the phone to direct us. The master bedroom smells cigarette smoke. We had to use the second bedroom instead for the night we stayed there.
More than excellent

It was the worst part of our trip to Egypt.  The host didn’t give us complete, or correct directions for how to find and enter the apartment.  The average place does not need much instruction, and most of the time it’s obvious.  In this case, the building was very hard to find, the lock box was not where they said it was, the elevator did not work without the key in the lockbox (which wasn’t outside the apt. door, as they said it would be). The actual apt. door didn’t open unless you knew to pull it tightly toward you while turning the key.  We juggled our 5 pieces of luggage all around this huge building, in 100 degree weather, trying to find the correct entrance, carrying our luggage up 5 flights of dark, broken stairs and being physically and mentally exhausted enough to skip the rest of the days plans and recuperate.  It took us 2 stressful hours and multiple phone calls to the host and Airbnb  to get into this place.  I gave them a chance to make up for this, so I wouldn’t have to leave a bad review, but all they could offer me was a “sorry” and $8.
The inside is fine.

The building also lost (off) water for a few hours during our stay. A bit unlucky.

Overall, we had a pleasant stay in Apartment 503 on Airport Road. The apartment is spacious, the interior design is modern, and the furniture and finishes feel new rather than outdated.
However, our main concerns were related to hygiene, maintenance, and child safety:
There was noticeable dust throughout the apartment upon arrival.
The artificial plants were covered in dust.
The balcony was also dusty and had not been properly cleaned.
The air conditioners are quite old. One was not working and another was leaking water.
The kitchen ustensiles and cookware were not clean, and the microwave also was smelly 
The water supply was frequently interrupted at night, so we had to store water in advance.
The apartment is not suitable for families with children under 4 years old. The doors are fitted with automatic self-closing mechanisms that shut forcefully, which was both inconvenient and raised safety concerns for our young daughter.
